name: Compressed olive and terracotta paper pulp | mobile terrain derivative v6
source: User-provided Olive Fiber texture set. Base color, normal and roughness structure are retained; the sphere render is never used as a texture.
derivation: Deterministic periodic filtering of user-provided 2048px color and +Y normal maps to 1024px. Reduced broad normal lobes, retained source fibers and layer boundaries, added seeded short fiber and micropore detail. Soil has its own reduced flake normal; no sphere render, photographed lighting or reference screenshot is sampled. ORM is authored micro-pore AO, roughness at least .94, zero metalness.
usage: Olive maps for grass tops and exposed pulp lip; dirt maps for cube sides/bottom. World-space UVs; no baked lighting.

textures.role: sRGB olive layered pulp top base color
linear tangent-space OpenGL +Y grass fiber normal; blue channel faces forward
linear R=micropore AO G=high paper roughness B=zero metalness
sRGB yellow-brown compressed cellulose stock; unlit base color
linear tangent-space OpenGL +Y short-fiber/granule/pore normal; positive forward blue
linear R=micropore AO G=high cellulose roughness B=zero metalness

soilDerivation.input: Existing v6 soil color derivative plus user OliveFiber_NormalGL.png; original grass maps unchanged.
soilDerivation.method: Deterministic periodic numpy/scipy filtering and wraparound irregular cellulose chips, short fibers and micropores. Two scales: fine stock detail plus 9-28-texel fragments, 8-21-texel short fiber bundles and sparse 3-8-texel pores survive mobile mipmaps. Strong suppression of broad flake color/normal lobes. Source color microstructure retained at reduced amplitude.
soilDerivation.color: Unlit yellow-brown kraft stock, intended RGB median 145,102,59 in sRGB. No photographic lighting or reference/render image sampled.
soilDerivation.normal: Independent height-derived tangent-space OpenGL +Y; positive blue/Z, periodic central differences; fine source normal detail retained.
soilDerivation.orm: Linear R=micropore AO G=high matte paper roughness B=zero metalness; no screen-space lighting baked.
